results.title: The Echo of the Herd
results.overview: Didier works on a cattle farm. Deaf from birth, he lives alone in an isolated house in the countryside. Since the death of his brother and only companion, Claude, he has taken refuge in his work. While the farm experiences a health crisis, Didier is driven by a critical need: to reinvent his language, to make himself understood and to transform his disability into a strength.

results.title: Rosa’s Waltz
results.overview: The lifelong relationship between Sebastián Cordero, a Latin American filmmaker, and his nanny Rosa, a woman who dedicated her entire life to someone else’s family. While Rosa has very little archive of her own life, she becomes the narrator of the director’s family history and its unexpected twists. This is, and isn’t, her story.

results.title: Howl
results.overview: Misfit Molly lives in a tent in her suburban backyard—but when she spots a wolf and no one believes her, she becomes obsessed with proving it's real.

results.title: Granny
results.overview: Rony, a home nurse movies into a remote house to take care of a strange old woman only know an 'Granny'. His sanity starts slipping as her behavior turns increasingly eccentric.

results.title: Das fast normale Leben
results.overview: The film observes the everyday lives of four girls in a residential group run by child and youth welfare services. Separated from their parents, they struggle for recognition, self-love, self-determination, and security. Always with the fervent desire to return home someday.

results.title: Carolina Blue
results.overview: On the cusp of adulthood, A 19-year-old woman who keeps putting off her life is forced into action when her grandfather stops putting off his, setting her on a journey to find him.

results.title: Same Same But Different
results.overview: An Iranian immigrant agrees to marry her boss's son to stay in the U.S., but their simple green card wedding on Cape Cod gets complicated when her two Iranian best friends arrive with their own American boyfriends and cross-cultural baggage in tow.

results.title: Riviera 76, le Woodstock oublié
results.overview: This legendary event was meant to be “the French Woodstock.” Almost no one remembers it today, because nothing — absolutely nothing — went according to plan... But in 2020, this extraordinary story resurfaced with the discovery of 153 metal canisters hidden away in a cellar, containing an untold number of film reels. Unseen for decades, these reels preserve the memory of an incredible chapter in music history : three days of a music festival at the height of the summer of 1976. A 350-hectare open-air site at the Paul Ricard Circuit in Le Castellet. The American organizers behind the legendary Woodstock at the helm. Joe Cocker roaring on stage. An expected crowd of 100,000. A budget of $1 million. The Rolling Stones' mobile recording truck on site to capture the performances for a live album... And yet, in the end, it all collapsed into spectacular failure—against the backdrop of the Var region's criminal underworld.

results.overview: Follows a man whose parents want to send him away as a house husband. A girl falls in love with him, but the story takes an unexpected turn involving investigation thriller elements.

results.title: Nika & Madison
results.overview: Fearing they won't be believed, two young Indigenous women go on the run after one's defense of the other results in a violent attack against a police officer.

results.title: No Problem
results.overview: Zuo Shouquan is the director of the morning paper in a north-eastern city. He has a daughter, Zuo Mingming, who lives with his ex-wife. The girl is neglecting her studies. She is not particularly interested in her education. Her father wants her to move and start working at his newspaper. Zuo Mingming won’t have it; she plays in a band and her only dream is to pursue a musical career in the south. Father versus daughter, north versus south – a deeply rooted conflict between different systems of values in a contemporary Chinese comedy.

results.title: The Astronaut
results.overview: After Valentina’s father returns from a space mission, he is unrecognizable.  She tries everything to restore their old relationship.

results.title: The Embalmer
results.overview: “Ang Bangkay” (The Embalmer) tells the story of the Corintho family who owns a funeral business.  The story begins with the death of the matriarch, Milagros, leaving Isabel to deal with the responsibility of dealing with the errands in the family business and the household left behind by her mom.

results.title: The Undying Pain of Existence
results.overview: A nude model is posing with statuesque stillness for an elite drawing class – until an unfortunate mosquito bite challenges his self-control. Driven to madness by the itch, he’s caught between the ruthless demand for perfection and his most unhinged, animalistic impulses.

results.title: Garuda: Dare to Dream
results.overview: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.
